ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated in speckles and at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense, stochastic distribution of high-contrast white focal spots across the entire black ventral surface; larger contiguous white clusters are mapped to the extreme left and right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 70-degree V-shaped central depression with a defined vertex and moderate depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge; significant jagged peaks (amplitude 5-10 pixels) visible on the outer lobes, transitioning to smoother contours near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters (2-5 pixel diameter) scattered across the ventral surface, with a high-density cluster on the upper right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct diagonal white linear disruptions visible on the inner-left lobe; smaller vertical linear marks visible on the lower-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular white scarring and potential calcification/growth at the extreme outer tip of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique dense speckling pattern covering >80% of the visible black pigmentation.
